title: Outpatient clinic risk register
goal: A clinic quality lead can see which risks need immediate mitigation.

rubric.must: A visible 5 by 5 likelihood-impact grid contains the named clinical risks.
Likelihood and impact scales are visibly labelled.
The highest-severity sepsis risk is visibly in the high likelihood/high impact region.
Risk cells use a clear severity progression.
Cell labels and values are legible.
